description:
Score 2 to 10 US locations and say how they differ.

Use this for "which of these is the most walkable", choosing between addresses, or any question that puts places side by side. Give addresses or coordinates, and a label for each if you want the results matched back to your own names.

Returns every location ranked, the best and worst, the spread between them, and the gap on each component. The per-component gap is usually the answer: two places can reach the same composite for opposite reasons, one with errands close by and dangerous streets, the other the reverse.

A location that cannot be resolved is reported in errors and the rest are still scored. Each location counts as one call against your allowance.

address.description: A US address. Give this or lat/lon.

label.description: Your name for this location, echoed back so you can match results to inputs.

name: compare_locations
